max_clause.text: To maximally empower end users and avoid being paternalistic, we prefer to place as many instructions as possible at this level. Unlike user defaults that can only be explicitly overridden, guidelines can be overridden implicitly (e.g., from contextual cues, background knowledge, or user history).

passage.quote: To maximally empower end users and avoid being paternalistic, we prefer to place as many instructions as possible at this level. Unlike user defaults that can only be explicitly overridden, guidelines can be overridden implicitly (e.g., from contextual cues, background knowledge, or user history).
